Google Drev ''Valgfrit samarbejde via Google Drive.'' Dette plugin er en tidlig test af en selvstændig webapp. Din lokale wiki fungerer stadig uden Google. 1. Byg og gem først din HTML-wiki som normalt. 2. Åbn den fælles ForgeDrive-webapp via knappen herunder. 3. Upload din lokale HTML-wiki ''én gang''. 4. Redigér Drive-kopien i webappen, og del den med en anden Google-konto som læser eller redaktør. <$set name="huwikiDriveAppUrl" filter="[[$:/config/huwiki/google-drive/app-url]get[text]]"> <$list filter="[prefix[https://script.google.com/macros/s/]]"> > target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Åbn HUWiki Google Drev ''Vigtigt:'' Dette er stadig en test. Den lokale download bliver ikke automatisk synkroniseret. Efter importen er Drive-kopien den fælles wiki. Dette er endnu ikke samtidig tiddlerbaseret samarbejde. Projekt og testvejledning: https://github.com/maans/huwiki-forge/tree/feat/google-drive-optional-bridge-spike/integrations/google-drive-apps-script"},"$:/plugins/huwiki/google-drive/ui-en":{"title":"$:/plugins/huwiki/google-drive/ui-en","type":"text/vnd.tiddlywiki","text":"! Google Drive ''Optional collaboration through Google Drive.'' This plugin is an early test of a standalone web app. Your local wiki still works without Google. 1. Build and save your HTML wiki normally. 2. Open the shared ForgeDrive web app using the link below. 3. Upload your local HTML wiki ''once''. 4. Edit the shared Drive copy in the app, then invite another Google account as reader or editor. <$set name="huwikiDriveAppUrl" filter="[[$:/config/huwiki/google-drive/app-url]get[text]]"> <$list filter="[prefix[https://script.google.com/macros/s/]]"> > target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Open HUWiki Google Drive ''Important:'' This is still a test. Your local download is not automatically synced. Once imported, the Drive copy is the shared version. This is not yet real-time tiddler-level collaboration. HUWiki Google Drev Optional Google Drive collaboration for single-file TiddlyWiki Editions. This experimental launcher does not change the standard TiddlyWiki saver. It opens the separate Apps Script editor. The editor uses the configured ForgeDrive test deployment, executes as the active Google user and shares a single HTML wiki through Google Drive's file permissions. * No Google Picker in daily use * No Gmail API, UrlFetchApp or Google account required for simply using the local wiki * Shared editing uses file-level versions, not automatic merge * Source: https://github.com/maans/huwiki-forge/tree/feat/google-drive-optional-bridge-spike/integrations/google-drive-apps-script"},"$:/config/huwiki/google-drive/app-url":{"title":"$:/config/huwiki/google-drive/app-url","text":"https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbxcW3X-jn0sUcNL1MKUg3RNp4UeG_4LqQyglAc9VlSKcB8mgHTAFUbO1BzAYM4tdwF-/exec","type":"text/plain"}}}
